goal: Tile expand overlay, glow and entrance (I7b): native dialog expand with reopen after a filter click, pointer glow, entrance within 0.6 s, reduced motion and reduced transparency.

acceptance_criteria.text: tiles.js: .ws-expand moves the tile into #tile-dialog (placeholder left behind), showModal(), then Plotly.Plots.resize on each .js-plotly-plot inside; the plot is wider than 0.8 x viewport; Esc (native cancel), a click whose target is the dialog itself (backdrop) or the expand button closes it, the tile returns to its place, plots resize, and .ws-expand gets focus

On pagehide with the dialog open sessionStorage['databoot.expand'] = '<dataset id>:<key>'; on load a matching present tile reopens expanded and the entry is deleted; clicking a bar inside the overlay (dashboard.js crossFilter unchanged) changes the URL (f.region=...), the chip and N of M counts, and after the load dialog[open] holds the same chart again

pointermove on a tile sets --mx/--my on it (not wired under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce); CSS entrance: max delay + duration <= 0.6 s, so document.getAnimations() for the tile entrances all finish within 600 ms of load (Playwright)

Under emulated prefers-reduced-motion: reduce no animation or transition runs (getAnimations() empty, glow variables never set); under prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce every element's computed backdropFilter is 'none' and the tile fill is opaque

tests/test_tile_interactions.py gains the expand, Esc, backdrop, reopen-after-filter, entrance and glow tests on sales (?app=explorer); python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_tile_interactions.py tests/test_filter_browser.py passes
Moves acceptance items AC-82, AC-84 forward

decisions.what: Only tiles.js and the tests changed; no CSS or template edits
decisions.why: databoot.css already had the dialog, glow, entrance, reduced-motion and reduced-transparency rules, and dataset.html already had #tile-dialog

decisions.what: Expanded tile gets is-settled when it moves into the dialog
decisions.why: Moving a node in the DOM restarts its CSS animation, so the tile would replay its entrance on return

decisions.what: One document-level click handler handles the expand button, the backdrop and the close button
decisions.why: The dialog is the click target for the backdrop, and the same button closes it when the tile is inside the dialog

decisions.what: Reduced transparency is emulated through CDP Emulation.setEmulatedMedia
decisions.why: Playwright's Python API has no option for prefers-reduced-transparency

tried_and_failed.what: First test versions read the DOM right after Esc/backdrop click, and asserted no ws-tile animations remain after the entrance
tried_and_failed.why_it_failed: The close event fires a task later, so the tile was not back yet; fill-mode both keeps finished animations in getAnimations(), so the test checks playState != finished instead

assumptions: Tile key chart-3 is the bar chart in the sales Explorer fixture (data_dir sales.csv)
The tile fill is checked opaque by its computed backgroundColor being rgb(...) or alpha 1 under reduced transparency

lessons.lesson: In Playwright tests of a native dialog, wait for the moved element (locator.wait_for) after Esc or a backdrop click before reading the DOM: the close event runs asynchronously
lessons.when: Testing code that restores DOM in a dialog close handler

lessons.lesson: A reload fires pagehide too, so a test that sets a sessionStorage reopen key must close the dialog first or the handler overwrites the key
Scroll a tile into view before reading its bounding box for mouse.move, or the pointer lands off-screen and the test passes or fails vacuously
lessons.when: Testing pointer glow on tiles below the fold
